Over de vacature

“De zoveelste vacature voor .NET developer”? Tuurlijk: ook in dit geval werk je in C#. En met de laatste technieken in VR, AR, BIM, sensoring, mobile devices, wearables en big data. What else is new? Toch kun je bij ons iets halen, dat je nergens anders
kunt krijgen. Iets waardoor jij als savvy developer bij ons past, als een
ELSE bij een IF
.
Dat zit ’m deels in de Europese onderzoeksprojecten waarin we deelnemen. In een werkweek spreek je in Teams zomaar vakgenoten van techbedrijven uit Italië, Duitsland en Spanje. No problemo trouwens: iedereen spreekt natuurlijk Engels. Maar wat je vooral nergens anders zult vinden, is onze benadering. En hoe we met 20 eigenwijze, maar vriendelijke collega’s, de wereld van vastgoedinformatiemanagement met toffe oplossingen
bestoken.

Over DEMO

DEMO Consultants is een onafhankelijk adviesbureau dat werkt vanuit drie business units: Advies, Software en Onderzoek. Met een pragmatische en resultaatgerichte aanpak stellen we de belangen van onze klanten altijd voorop. Innovatie staat centraal; door onderzoek houden we onze kennis up-to-date en verbeteren we onze adviezen. Maatschappelijke verantwoordelijkheid is voor ons een vanzelfsprekendheid, DEMO wil graag bijdragen aan een duurzame, sociaal en cultureel rijke samenleving. Onze platte organisatiestructuur stimuleert eigen initiatief en persoonlijke groei. Ongeveer de helft van de opdrachten van DEMO komen van Nederlandse opdrachtgevers en de andere helft speelt zich af in Europese context.

Wat bieden wij

Toffe Europese onderzoeksprojecten • Zelfgemaakte, innovatieve vastgoed-tech • 32 – 40 uur • Delft

✓ €3.000,00 – €6.000,00 p/maand ✓ Thuiswerkmogelijkheden ✓ 25 vakantiedagen ✓ Op maat gemaakte studie- en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden

Enthousiast geworden? Mooi!

jobs.title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
jobs.description:
*Research shows that some candidates often feel confident enough to apply when they meet about 60% of the job requirements, whereas other candidates tend to apply only when they meet all the criteria. If this role truly suits you but you’re unsure whether you meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.

About Virtual Vaults

Virtual Vaults is the leading data room provider in the Benelux and expanding rapidly across Europe. Founded to simplify and accelerate dealmaking for the mid-market, it has become the trusted partner for advisors and deal teams who value clarity, control, and speed. The platform brings preparation, diligence, and closing together in one connected environment, supported by transparent pricing and a customer success team that stays engaged at every stage. By reducing friction and cost while improving quality, Virtual Vaults helps dealmakers move faster and close with confidence.

From idea to production

You have a knack for turning unclear challenges into clear, actionable plans. You bring people together, drive decisions, and follow through to ensure solutions deliver real value. Because for you, the job isn’t finished when the code is merged. It’s finished when the outcome works for the people who depend on it.

We're looking for a hands-on senior engineer to join our Workspaces or Data Room team. You'll work across .NET, Angular, and Azure, using AI to support your engineering work and building AI capabilities into our products. You'll help shape the solution, write the code, and stay involved through release and production operations.

You’ll be part of a multidisciplinary team that combines different perspectives to build the best possible product. Together with a team lead, medior developers, QA engineers and product designers, you’ll collaborate closely to solve complex challenges, refine ideas, and deliver valuable solutions. Everyone contributes to shaping the product, and you’ll have the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and overall user experience.

What you will own

Delivery from start to finish
. Clarify requirements with your team, agree what success looks like, and take features through implementation, testing, release, and production verification. Close the follow-up work too.
A workable plan for complex problems.
Break projects and operational changes into manageable steps. Make dependencies and risks visible, identify a useful first release, and adjust the plan as you learn. Keep an overview of the whole process.
Clear, proactive communication.
Keep colleagues and stakeholders informed without waiting to be asked. Raise risks early, explain the trade-offs, and bring a recommendation. Present your work in team discussions and product demos.
Full-stack engineering.
Build and maintain backend services, frontend experiences, and infrastructure as code. Contribute to architecture, automated testing, performance, and safe delivery.
Practical AI.
Use coding assistants and agents thoughtfully, reviewing and testing their output. Build AI-enabled features and evaluate their usefulness, accuracy, security, cost, and latency.
Reliable, secure operation.
Help respond to incidents, investigate root causes, assess risks, and complete improvements that prevent repeat problems. Protect customer data throughout the system.
A stronger team
. Be a technical leader, share knowledge, review code, mentor colleagues, and welcome constructive challenges.

Ownership here is shared accountability, not doing everything alone. We value people who involve others early, ask for help when needed, and keep responsibility for the outcome.

What you will bring to the table

Your way of working

A track record of finishing substantial work. You can explain what you personally delivered, how you handled setbacks, and how you knew the result was working in production.
The ability to create structure when requirements are incomplete, coordinate across teams, and keep progress moving without repeated chasing.
Excellent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level). You can lead a technical discussion, write a precise update, and explain a complex issue to a non-technical colleague. Dutch is a strong plus.

Your engineering foundation

C# / .NET:
6+ years of professional C# development, with recent hands-on experience building and maintaining production services and APIs.
Angular / TypeScript:
Practical production experience and the ability to independently deliver the frontend side of a feature, not only its backend.
Azure and delivery:
Hands-on experience with Azure PaaS, containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting. AI-200 (or AZ-204) certification is a plus.
Messaging:
Experience with Azure Service Bus or equivalent, including retries, duplicate delivery, and failure recovery.
Quality and security:
Automated testing, pragmatic architecture, safe releases, and a security-first approach. You understand tenant-scoped authorization, least privilege, secrets management, and keeping sensitive information out of logs.
Education:
A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

AI is part of the basics

You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and can show how you check their output, catch mistakes, and protect confidential code and data through approved tooling.
You've implemented AI features or working prototypes and can explain your contribution and how you evaluated the results.
You understand large language models (LLMs), embeddings, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including their limitations and when they are useful.
You understand Model Context Protocol (MCP) and how it connects AI applications to tools and data with authenticated, least-privilege access.
You account for hallucinations and prompt injection, enforce tenant authorization before retrieval or tool execution, and keep sensitive prompts, document contents, and personal data out of logs. You don't rely on prompts to enforce access control.

We're looking for practical application engineering and sound judgment, not a model-training specialist.

What we offer you

A hands-on role with room to influence both the product and how it's built. You'll work in an open, flat, collaborative team where sharing knowledge, asking questions, and improving the way we work are part of the job.
Salary: €6.000 – €7.500 depending on skills and experience
32-40 hours per week with flexible working hours (hybrid work, with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home, based on 40 hours per week
27 vacation days.
100% pension contribution paid by Virtual Vaults.
NS Business Card for commute, or a allowance of 23ct per kilometer (based on living a minimum of 10km from the office)
Training budget for personal and professional development
A professional, ambitious and informal work environment
Fun company events and team outings
Daily fresh lunch and fruit provided at the office

Let's talk

An informal video call (15-30 minutes):
We'll discuss your experience, what you're looking for, and the role.
An onsite interview with potential future colleagues (60 minutes)
: We'll explore the work you've delivered, how you approach complex problems, and your engineering and AI experience. There will be time for your questions, too. It will be a two-way conversation, to make sure you van also determine if we are a match for you.
A case, which is to be made at home:
You’ll work on a case that mirrors a real-world challenge. We’re interested not just in the end result, but also in how you think, prioritize, and solve problems.
Onsite case presentation (60 minutes):
You’ll present your case to the team and talk us through your reasoning, choices, and conclusion. It’s a chance for us to learn more about how you work and for you to get a feel for how we collaborate.
An offer
if we're a mutual match.

Interested?
Apply with your CV and motivation.

Disclaimer for Recruitment Agencies:
Virtual Vaults does not accept unsolicited CVs or candidate profiles. Without a prior written agreement, any submissions become the property of Virtual Vaults and no compensation will be owed.

Our client is a Dutch family-owned manufacturer of special transport vehicles and environmental loading systems deployed by logistics operators and municipalities worldwide. Founded in the 1800's, they have grown to over 3,000 employees across 15 countries and 4 operating divisions.

They are in the middle of a deliberate digital transformation. Telematics platforms, connected vehicle data, and global service operations all run on cloud infrastructure that is actively being built out. A key pillar of this transformation is the ongoing migration of multiple ERPs across divisions to Microsoft Dynamics 365. This is not a caretaker role because foundational architectural decisions are still being made.

🎯 WHAT YOU'LL DO

– Design and maintain multi-cloud architecture (primarily Azure, with AWS workloads) across all divisions
– Build and manage CI/CD pipelines with software engineering teams (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions)
– Own the infrastructure-as-code codebase: Terraform and Azure Bicep
– Architect and operate container platforms (Kubernetes / AKS) for production services
– Manage IoT ingestion pipelines for vehicle fleet telematics: Azure IoT Hub, Event Hubs
– Lead cloud security and compliance: identity, network segmentation, GDPR across jurisdictions
– Drive FinOps: cost allocation, waste identification, reserved capacity planning
– Set up observability stacks and define SLOs for critical platform services
– Contribute to disaster recovery planning and DR exercises across international infrastructure

⚙️ TECH STACK

Azure · Microsoft Dynamics 365 · Terraform · Kubernetes/AKS · Azure DevOps · GitHub Actions · Azure Bicep · Azure IoT Hub · Event Hubs · Entra ID · Python · PowerShell · Docker · Prometheus/Grafana · Azure Monitor · Log Analytics · SAP (integration layer)

✅ REQUIRED

– 7+ years in cloud engineering or DevOps in production environments
– Solid hands-on experience with Azure (compute, networking, storage, identity)
– Infrastructure-as-code: Terraform and/or Bicep
– Container orchestration: Kubernetes in any managed form (AKS, EKS, GKE)
– CI/CD pipeline design and maintenance
– Scripting in Python or PowerShell
– Security foundations: RBAC, network security groups, secrets management
– Strong written and spoken English; Dutch is an advantage

💡 NICE TO HAVE

– Azure certification (AZ-104, AZ-305) or equivalent AWS cert
– Experience with IoT or industrial telemetry platforms
– FinOps practices and cloud cost governance
– Background in manufacturing, logistics, or OT environments
– Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 (implementation, integration, or migration)
– SAP integration or ERP connectivity
– Familiarity with ISO 27001 or NIS2
– Multi-entity, multi-country IT environments

🎁 WHAT'S ON OFFER
– Greenfield cloud platform: your architecture decisions will stand for years
– 25 vacation days + ATV reduction days (Dutch CAO)
– Hybrid working: 2–3 days in Utrecht
– Learning budget and certification costs covered
– Company car or mobility allowance
– Pension plan via Metaal & Techniek sector fund
– Small IT team with direct access to stakeholders

jobs.title: Senior .NET Software Developer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Über Uns

Seit unserer Gründung 1998 ist die QualityHosting auf Microsoft-Technologien für geschäftskritische IT-Anwendungen spezialisiert. Wir sind Microsoft Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) und Deutschlands Marktführer für Hosted Exchange. Unser Unternehmen bietet ein erweitertes Cloud-Portfolio inklusive Microsoft 365, Copilot & AI sowie leistungsfähige CloudServer für Unternehmen jeder Größe an.

Für unser Entwicklungsteam in Frankfurt am Main und Gelnhausen suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen erfahrenen Senior .NET Software Developer (m/w/d)
für die Weiterentwicklung unserer Cloud-Plattform.

Über unsere Web-Anwendungen beziehen und verwalten Kunden und Partner ihre Microsoft-Cloud-Services im Self-Service. Dazu gehören unter anderem:
unser Cloud-Marketplace zum Buchen und Verwalten von Abonnements
Verwaltungsportale für Endkunden und Reseller
Managed Security 365 zum laufenden Schutz von Microsoft-365-Umgebungen
Backend-Prozesse zur automatisierten Bereitstellung und Abrechnung von Microsoft-365-, CSP- und Azure-Diensten

Deine Aufgaben

Du entwickelst rund 50 bis 70 Prozent
deiner Zeit selbst – an den oben genannten Web-Anwendungen und Backend-Prozessen.
Du organisierst und priorisierst die Entwicklungsarbeit und sorgst dafür, dass das Team jederzeit Klarheit darüber hat, welche Themen als Nächstes umgesetzt werden.
Du verantwortest den Backlog und übersetzt Anforderungen aus Support, Account Management und Geschäftsführung in klar definierte und umsetzbare Arbeitspakete.
Du formulierst präzise Specs, mit denen sowohl Entwickler als auch Coding Agents zuverlässig arbeiten können.
Du strukturierst Aufgaben so, dass mehrere Claude-Code-Agenten parallel und möglichst konfliktfrei
arbeiten können, und planst Review-, Test- und Verifikationsschritte von Anfang an mit ein.
Du entwickelst unser technisches Projektgedächtnis aus CLAUDE.md, Claude Skills und MCP-Anbindungen
weiter und machst Wissen für Entwickler und Agents gleichermaßen nutzbar.
Du organisierst die Zusammenarbeit im Team mit leichtgewichtigen Sprints, Refinements und Retrospektiven – pragmatisch und passend zu unserer Teamgröße statt mit unnötigem Prozess-Overhead.
Du koordinierst Releases unserer .NET-Anwendungen und stellst sicher, dass vereinbarte Qualitätsstandards, Tests, Contracts und Definition of Done eingehalten werden.
Du stellst die Qualität der Umsetzung sicher und hinterfragst AI-generierten Code genauso kritisch wie menschlich geschriebenen Code.

Das bringst du mit

Mehrjährige professionelle Erfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung mit C# und .NET
, idealerweise an gewachsenen Anwendungen mit anspruchsvoller Fachlogik im produktiven Betrieb.
Praktische Erfahrung mit AI-gestützter bzw. agentischer Softwareentwicklung
, die deutlich über Autocomplete und einzelne Copilot-Vorschläge hinausgeht.
Idealerweise hast du bereits intensiv mit Claude Code
gearbeitet und Erfahrung damit, Specs für Agents zu schreiben, mehrere Agents parallel einzusetzen und Kontext bzw. Projektwissen strukturiert für Agents bereitzustellen.
Erfahrung mit agiler Arbeitsorganisation
, beispielsweise Scrum oder Kanban, sowie mit Priorisierung, Stakeholder-Management und Moderation. Zertifikate wie PSM oder CSM sind willkommen – gelebte Praxis ist uns wichtiger.
Eine ausgeprägte Verifikations- und Qualitätsorientierung: Du verlässt dich weder bei menschlichem noch bei AI-generiertem Code auf den ersten Entwurf, sondern setzt auf Tests, Reviews und Smoke-Checks.
Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse.
Hands-on-Mentalität und Entscheidungsfreude. Du hast Lust, in einem kleinen Team mit flachen Hierarchien zwischen eigener Entwicklung, Organisation, Priorisierung und Qualitätssicherung zu wechseln.

Nice-To-Have

Erfahrung mit SaaS- und Self-Service-Anwendungen
, insbesondere Multi-Tenancy und Subscription-Modellen
Erfahrung mit cloud-nativer Architektur auf Azure
, beispielsweise Worker-Patterns, Managed Services und resilienten Architekturen
Claude Skills, MCP-Server oder Automatisierungen
rund um Claude Code
Microsoft-Cloud-Domänenwissen, beispielsweise CSP/Partner Center, Microsoft 365 oder Entra ID

Erfahrung mit CI/CD sowie GitHub Actions und Azure DevOps

Darum lohnt es sich

Arbeiten, wie es zu dir passt
Hybrides Arbeiten ist bei uns keine Ausnahme, sondern Normalität: 2 Tage Home-Office, 3 Tage im Office – so bleibst du flexibel und trotzdem nah am Team.
Ein Job mit Zukunft
Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag bei einem etablierten Cloud-Dienstleister mit Standorten in Frankfurt am Main und Gelnhausen.
Dein Budget, deine Entwicklung
2.000 € Weiterbildungsbudget pro Jahr – für Zertifizierungen, Konferenzen, Bücher oder Coaching. Plus kostenfreie Sprachkurse on top.
Gut abgesichert & fair vergütet
Betriebliche Altersvorsorge, bei der wir deinen Beitrag verdoppeln – plus ein faires Bonussystem on top.
Extras, die sich summieren
Firmenrabatte bei Adidas, Apple, Expedia, home24 und vielen weiteren Partnern – plus 400 € jährliches Budget für unseren QualityHosting-Merch-Shop.
Ein Team, das zusammenhält
Flache Hierarchien, agile Strukturen und ein herzliches Miteinander – inklusive der Flexibilität, die Familie und Beruf unter einen Hut bringt. Dazu regelmäßige Team-Events und der ein oder andere gemeinsame BBQ-Abend im Sommer.
Dein Standort, deine Wahl
Ruhige Lage in Gelnhausen mit kostenfreiem Parkplatz oder unser modernes Glasbüro in Frankfurt mit JobTicket-Übernahme – du entscheidest.

Own the architecture of the software platform on which Constructor Labs' quantum group builds. Own the end-to-end architecture across backend services, job orchestration, hardware abstraction and device state management.

Set and enforce engineering standards: testing, review, structured logging, dependency governance.
Remove single points of failure so no component has only one person who understands it.

Success Metrics and KPIs: test coverage, review discipline, bus factor above one on every core component.

Pillar 3 Working with Research

Work day to day with research physicists, translating experimental workflows into software.
Keep the research and engineering collaboration model intact as the group grows.
Support the product function with realistic estimates and honest technical constraints.

Accountability: research team able to run experiments without engineering bottlenecks.

10+ years building production software systems, with real depth in Python, C#/.NET or C++.

Track record as the senior technical voice in a small team.

Strong written communication. Decisions that are not written down do not exist.

This role IS

Deeply hands-on, with real authority over technical direction.

– Du unterstützt führende Unternehmen bei der Gestaltung moderner, skalierbarer Cloud- und AI-Architekturen und begleitest sie auf ihrem Weg zu einer datengetriebenen, AI-gestützten Organisation. Als Expert:in für AI & Cloud entwickelst du maßgeschneiderte End-to-End-Lösungen - von der Cloud-Zielarchitektur über Data & AI Platforms bis hin zu produktiven Machine-Learning- und Generative-AI-Anwendungen - die den individuellen Anforderungen der Kunden entsprechen. About Indra Group UK & Ireland

Indra is a leading global technology and consulting company, and a trusted technological partner for the core business operations of its clients worldwide. It stands at the forefront of key sectors including Transport, Defence, Air Traffic Management and Space, alongside advanced Information Technology services delivered through Minsait, and cutting-edge capabilities in Sovereign AI, Cybersecurity, and Cyberdefence via IndraMind.

The company's business model is built around a comprehensive portfolio of proprietary products, combining strong innovation with a high-value focus for customers.

With more than 2,500 projects implemented across 50 countries and over 100 cities, Indra is a global benchmark in innovative transportation and mobility solutions. It is recognised as one of the world's top three companies in public transportation management systems. Indra's technology supports the daily journeys of over 78 million people, helping to reduce more than 10 million tonnes of CO₂ emissions annually, and helping save nearly 3,000 lives through improved traffic management and road safety.

Indra Group is paving the way to a more secure and better-connected future through innovative solutions, trusted relationships and the very best talent. Sustainability sits at the heart of its strategy and culture, driving efforts to address current and future social and environmental challenges.

In the 2024 financial year, Indra achieved revenues of €5.5 billion, over 60,000 professionals, maintained a local presence in 46 countries, and operated across more than 140 countries worldwide.

As the technological partner for its customers' key operations, Indra is at the core of their business, and Indra's four values guide everything we do:

Innovation
- Our capacity for innovation, cutting-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enables us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology.

Trust
- We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society.

Connection
- We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers' needs, supporting them on the path to a better future.

Foresight
- We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow.

About The Project

Transport for London (TfL) has awarded Indra a long-term contract to operate, develop, enhance and expand ticketing and access control systems across London's transport network through to 2034, with extension options to 2039.

This programme covers the maintenance, operation and evolution of a large-scale, complex ecosystem, including turnstiles, validators, ticket machines, sales terminals, back-office systems, payment gateways, IT infrastructure and cybersecurity that supports over 8.6 million daily journeys.

Therefore, Indra will become TfL's strategic technology partner to guarantee the operation and evolution of the world's largest and most sophisticated ticketing system. Following a transition period of approximately two years, Indra will serve as the sole provider across the network that includes more than 8,500 buses, nearly 400 Underground stations, around 300 rail stations (Overground, DLR, Elizabeth Line and suburban services), 4,000 Oyster Card outlets, seven customer service centres, and 24 river boat boarding points.

Drawing on over 30 years of experience in urban public transport solutions, Indra will manage and evolve all aspects of the system. The project also envisages, in partnership with TfL, the implementation of new technologies to develop the system, make it more efficient and automate key processes; in short, to jointly create the next generation of the ticketing system for London.

We are looking for a Senior Business Central Developer on behalf of our client to lead the technical design, development, and customization of core Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central solutions. In this role, you will take operational ownership of complex ERP extensions—architecting robust AL codebases, integrating third-party systems via web services, and optimizing database performance across multi-tenant cloud environments.

You will treat ERP customization as a modern, disciplined software engineering practice. Rather than building intrusive base-code modifications, you will design clean, event-driven AL extensions using Visual Studio Code, establish automated release pipelines with AL Go and GitHub Actions, and ensure all features comply with Microsoft AppSource certification standards.

What we are looking for:

5+ years of dedicated software development experience with Dynamics 365 Business Central (and legacy Dynamics NAV), featuring expert-level proficiency in AL language, custom page/report extensions, codeunits, and event subscribers.
Strong functional and technical command of standard Business Central modules, including Finance (GL, AP, AR), Supply Chain, Inventory, Purchasing, and Sales.
Extensive experience connecting Business Central with external systems, CRMs, and e-commerce platforms using RESTful web services, OData, JSON, and OAuth2 authentication.
Daily practice authoring automated unit and integration tests using the AL Test Framework, utilizing test isolation and mocks to ensure upgrade stability.
Proven experience maintaining source code, versioning, and automated build pipelines using GitHub Actions, AL Go for GitHub, or Azure DevOps.
Deep understanding of SQL Server fundamentals, Business Central telemetry, index tuning, and performance profiling to eliminate lockups and slow-running queries.
Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Nice-to-Have & Plus Skills

Practical experience navigating Microsoft AppSource validation workflows and technical compliance checks.
Familiarity with the broader Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and Dataverse synchronization.
Exposure to Azure cloud services (Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Key Vault).
Background in migrating legacy C/AL codebases (Dynamics NAV) to modern AL extensions.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain scalable Business Central extensions in AL using event-driven architectures to customize ERP business logic cleanly.
Architect secure web service integrations between Business Central and external applications (ERPs, CRMs, banking networks, e-commerce storefronts).
Analyze system logs and telemetry using Business Central performance profilers and Application Insights to resolve locking, slow requests, and resource bottlenecks.
Establish and manage automated build, test, and release workflows using GitHub Actions and AL Go across development, staging, and production environments.
Enforce strict coding standards, conduct peer code reviews, and ensure codebases strictly adhere to Microsoft's technical guidelines for cloud upgrades and AppSource publication.

Role: Solution Architect - Data Platform

🟡 Languages: Fluent Polish & English

🟡 Salary: B2B contract 150-200 PLN h/net + VAT

The role combines hands-on architectural work with close collaboration with implementation teams and stakeholders, from shaping the solution to supporting its delivery.

What you'll actually work on?

Gather requirements and translate business and technical needs into data platform architectures.
Design enterprise-scale Data Platforms, Data Warehouses, Data Lakehouses, ETL processes and Machine Learning solutions.
Identify where AI can add value within a data platform and help clients translate potential use cases into practical platform requirements.
Consider how data platforms should evolve to support AI-driven solutions, taking into account data availability, access, governance and scalability.
Define architecture across connectivity, authentication and authorization, CI/CD, data access, governance, scalability and cost management.
Work with clients on data strategy and help shape practical approaches to adopting and modernizing cloud data platforms.
Prepare cloud adoption roadmaps, project documentation, estimations and delivery timelines.
Support implementation teams from concept through delivery, providing architectural guidance and helping resolve complex technical challenges.
Stay close to evolving Data Platform and AI architecture patterns and assess how new capabilities can be applied to real project needs.

What you'll work with?

Azure | Databricks | Delta Lake | Delta Live Tables | Unity Catalog | Azure Data Factory | SQL | CI/CD | AI / ML

You'll work with Azure infrastructure and identity components, including VNETs and VMs, as well as Cloud Adoption Framework concepts across enterprise and data environments.

You'll probably enjoy working with us if...

You like turning complex business and technical requirements into architectures that teams can actually implement.
You're interested not only in building data platforms, but also in finding the right place for AI within them.
You enjoy exploring how AI can be supported by the underlying data, architecture and governance rather than treating it as a separate layer.
You enjoy working at both the strategic level and close to the technical details.
You are comfortable bringing different perspectives together and moving architectural decisions forward.
You can explain technical trade-offs clearly to business stakeholders, engineers and technology leaders.
You like taking ownership of difficult architectural questions rather than waiting for a predefined solution.
You keep an eye on how data platform and AI architecture is evolving and enjoy exploring what new capabilities can bring to projects.

This collaboration might not be for you if...

You're looking for one predictable project that will stay largely unchanged for the next few years.
You want to receive a finished specification, build exactly what's written there and move to the next topic.
You'd rather stay away from client conversations and collaboration with different stakeholders.

Elitmind is a consulting company.
Projects, clients, industries and technologies change. You'll collaborate with experienced people around you, but you'll also have a lot of freedom and responsibility for figuring out how to move your own area forward.

Help build Enterprise IQ

Build the Data & AI foundations behind more intelligent organizations, connecting data, analytics, AI and business context to turn technology into better decisions, smarter actions and measurable value.
Close to Microsoft

As one of Microsoft's key partners in Poland, we get early exposure to new technologies and solutions across the Microsoft ecosystem.

Real autonomy

Talent has no borders. Proxify's mission is to connect top developers around the world with the opportunities they deserve. So, it doesn't matter where you are; we are here to help you fast-track your independent career in the right direction. 🙂

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer specializing in Microsoft Azure on behalf of our client to design, automate, and maintain high-availability cloud infrastructure. In this role, you will take operational ownership of enterprise Azure landing zones, container orchestration, and CI/CD pipeline automation—ensuring high reliability, cost efficiency, and zero-trust security compliance. You are a perfect candidate if you are growth-oriented, you love what you do, and you enjoy working on new ideas to develop exciting products.

5+ years of hands-on cloud engineering experience managing enterprise Microsoft Azure environments, spanning compute, networking (VNets, ExpressRoute, Application Gateways), and storage tiers.
Advanced mastery of Terraform or Bicep for provision automation, drift detection, and maintaining state files across multi-subscription environments.

Deep proficiency in constructing automated build and deployment pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, enforcing automated security scanning, policy compliance, and zero-downtime releases.
Solid understanding of cloud security governance using Microsoft Entra ID (formerly Azure AD), Azure Key Vault, Azure Policy, and implementing Role-Based Access Control (RBAC) under a Zero Trust model.
Experience configuring end-to-end monitoring and alerting using Azure Monitor, Log Analytics, Application Insights, or third-party platforms (Datadog, Dynatrace).
Located in CET timezone (+/- 3 hours), we are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Azure certifications such as AZ-104 (Azure Administrator), AZ-305 (Azure Solutions Architect), or AZ-400 (DevOps Engineer Expert).
Programming literacy in Python, Go, or PowerShell/Bash for infrastructure scripting and operator development.
Experience with cloud cost optimization frameworks (FinOps) and managing Azure Cost Management policies.

jobs.title: Manager of AI Engineering
jobs.description:
Galderma is the emerging pure-play dermatology category leader, present in approximately 90 countries. We deliver an innovative, science-based portfolio of premium flagship brands and services that span the full spectrum of the fast-growing dermatology market through Injectable Aesthetics, Dermatological Skincare and Therapeutic Dermatology. Since our foundation in 1981, we have dedicated our focus and passion to the human body's largest organ - the skin - meeting individual consumer and patient needs with superior outcomes in partnership with healthcare professionals. Because we understand that the skin, we are in shapes our lives, we are advancing dermatology for every skin story.

We look for people who focus on getting results, embrace learning and bring a positive energy. They must combine initiative with a sense of teamwork and collaboration. Above all, they must be passionate about doing something meaningful for consumers, patients, and the healthcare professionals we serve every day. We aim to empower each employee and promote their personal growth while ensuring business needs are met now and into the future. Across our company, we embrace diversity and respect the dignity, privacy, and personal rights of every employee.

At Galderma, we actively give our teams reasons to believe in our bold ambition to become the leading dermatology company in the world. With us, you have the ultimate opportunity to gain new and challenging work experiences and create an unparalleled, direct impact.

Role: Manager of AI Engineering

Location:
Cracow, Hybrid (3 days a week from office)

Based in our new IT hub at Unity Tower in Krakow, this is an exciting opportunity to join Galderma’s growing IT presence in Poland as a Manager of AI Engineering.

Galderma is building a dedicated enterprise AI capability to deliver secure, scalable solutions across the organisation. As Manager of AI Engineering, you will lead the technical execution of our AI Factory, overseeing the architecture, engineering standards, and operational reliability of AI solutions from concept through to production.

Reporting to the Senior Manager of AI & Automation, you will translate business demand into robust technical designs, assess feasibility of new use cases, and ensure solutions are delivered with strong lifecycle management and production discipline. Working closely with data, security, legal, and business teams, you will help establish the engineering foundations that enable responsible and sustainable AI at scale.

Key Responsibilities

AI Factory Delivery & Execution: Own end‑to‑end delivery of AI products/solutions from backlog to production; drive predictable execution, quality, and timely releases.
Architecture & Platform Stewardship: Define target architecture for AI solutions (APIs, integrations, data flows, identity/access); steward reusable components, reference patterns, and guardrails.
MLOps / LLMOps & Operational Excellence: Implement CI/CD for models and prompts, evaluation pipelines, monitoring (performance, drift, safety), incident response, and reliable rollbacks; ensure strong transition‑to‑operations.
Security, Privacy, and Responsible AI by Design: Embed security controls, privacy requirements, and responsible AI measures (human-in-the-loop, content safety, auditability) throughout the SDLC.
Engineering Standards & Quality: Set coding standards, testing strategy, documentation, and code review discipline; enforce non‑functional requirements (latency, availability, resilience).
Stakeholder & Vendor Management: Partner with business/product owners and data teams; manage strategic vendors and tool providers; support budget and capacity planning for the AI Factory.
People Leadership: Hire, develop, and retain a high‑performing engineering team; create growth plans and a learning culture; foster collaboration across a global matrix.

Skills And Qualifications

8+ years in software/AI engineering with 3+ years leading engineering teams.
Proven track record delivering AI/ML or GenAI solutions into production, including monitoring and operations.
Hands‑on experience with modern ML/LLM stacks, APIs, data pipelines, and integration in enterprise environments.
Strong experience collaborating with security, privacy, and legal to ship compliant solutions.
Strong English speaking and writing skills

What We Offer In Return

You will be working for an organization that embraces diversity & inclusion and believe we will deliver better outcomes by reflecting the perspectives of our diverse customer base.
You will receive a competitive compensation package with bonus structure and extended benefit package.
You will be able to work in a hybrid work culture.
You will participate in feedback loops, during which a personalized career path will be established.
You will be joining a growing company that believes in ownership from day one where everyone is empowered to grow and to take on accountability.

Next Steps

If your profile is a match, we will invite you for a first virtual conversation with the recruiter.
The next step is a virtual conversation with the hiring manager and the wider team.
The final step is an in-person interview with the local HRBP

Our people make a difference

At Galderma, you’ll work with people who are like you. And people that are different. We value what every member of our team brings. Professionalism, collaboration, and a friendly, supportive ethos is the perfect environment for people to thrive and excel in what they do.

jobs.description:
Posting Type

Hybrid/Remote

Job Overview

WHO WE ARE

Relativity is a leading legal data intelligence company building technology that helps users organize data, discover the truth, and act on it with confidence. Our AI-powered, cloud platform, RelativityOne, transforms massive volumes of complex information into actionable insights for litigation, investigations, regulatory inquiries, data breach responses, and other high-stakes legal work where accuracy and trust are crucial.

The world’s largest law firms, corporations, and government agencies rely on Relativity’s legal AI software to securely surface and manage the most relevant and impactful information in their matters. Beyond our commercial impact, we are committed to expanding access to technology and supporting pro bono legal work.

What We Do

You will join Relativity’s Import Export organization, a high-impact engineering team at the heart of our Ingestion Department. The team builds and scales the infrastructure that powers secure, reliable, and high-throughput data movement across the SaaS platform.

At Relativity, engineers do more than write code - they build systems that enable users to uncover insights from complex data at scale using cloud-native architecture, AI, and modern tools.

About The Role

As a Senior Full Stack Software Engineer, your primary mission will be to design, write, test, deploy, and support Relativity software products. You will work in an established senior team with business stakeholders to develop the product, features, and services that drive and evolve RelativityOne SaaS.

Job Description And Requirements

WHAT YOU’LL DO

Create architecture and non-functional design for Import/Export services that meet SLO/SLA targets.
Decompose complex problems into resilient, cloud-native designs.
Deliver milestones with measurable outcomes.
Advise and mentor team members on code quality, technical debt management, and best practices.
Own production systems by leading on-call procedures, root cause analyses, and proactive issue resolution that reduces MTTR.
Drive operational excellence using observability data to prioritize work, automate alerts, and expose trustworthy metrics.
Shape the roadmap with Product through clear trade-offs and data-backed decisions.
Optimize CI/CD by designing automation that keeps deployments predictable and compliant.
Build front-end architecture for Import/Export user experiences using React and TypeScript.
Build accessible, performant UIs with modern React, including hooks and context, and reliable state management.
Partner with Design to evolve a reusable component library and design system and enforce UI standards.

Required

WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

Advanced React with TypeScript.
Front-end testing expertise integrated into CI pipelines.
5+ years of experience shipping C#/.NET or similar services with measurable reliability or performance gains.
Experience architecting distributed SaaS systems and translating business needs into resilient designs.
Production ownership experience, including leading on-call rotations and root cause analyses and using telemetry to reduce MTTR and incident volume.
Experience with cloud-native delivery; any cloud is acceptable, and the team is on Azure.
Hands-on experience with CI/CD automation, automated testing, and deployment governance.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent experience.
English fluency for technical communication.

Preferred

Experience leading microservice work for high-volume event-driven workloads.
Experience mentoring teams in frontend development, UI, and accessibility.
Experience building and maintaining design systems and component libraries.

WHY WE COULD BE A GREAT FIT

Impactful Mission

Build systems that help customers organize data, discover the truth, and act on it in high-stakes legal matters.

Engineering at Scale

Work on distributed, cloud-native systems that process large volumes of data.

Cutting-Edge Technology

Build with AI, cloud platforms, and scalable architectures shaping legal tech.

Growth and Ownership

Gain experience owning systems end-to-end across cloud and distributed environments.

Collaborative Culture

Work in a team focused on knowledge sharing and continuous improvement.

Inclusive Environment

Diverse perspectives create stronger teams and better outcomes.

Compensation And Benefits

Competitive salary, benefits, DTO, parental leave, and equity program.

Relativity is committed to competitive, fair, and equitable compensation practices.

This position is eligible for total compensation which includes a competitive base salary, an annual performance bonus, and long-term incentives.

The expected salary range for this role is between following values:

208 000 and 312 000PLN

The final offered salary will be based on several factors, including but not limited to the candidate's depth of experience, skill set, qualifications, and internal pay equity. Hiring at the top end of the range would not be typical, to allow for future meaningful salary growth in this position.

Required Skills

Automation, Data Analysis, Database Management, Network Architecture, Performance Optimizations, Problem Solving, Project Management, Software Development, System Designs, Technical Leadership

SEB’s IT Asset Management team is looking for an Integration Developer with strong .NET, API, SQL and BI development skills, someone who enjoys building reliable integrations, working with complex data flows, and turning data into useful insights through analytics solutions. 

SEB is more than a bank. We are a technology-driven financial institution where everything starts from our customer needs and business outcomes. AI, data and modern engineering are natural parts of how we work, build and deliver value. From core banking platforms to agentic AI , automation, cybersecurity and cloud, we offer a broad tech landscape and many paths to grow. Together, we are shaping secure, responsible and future- proof solutions for our customers and society. Are you ready to take on a new challenge?

You will join our dynamic Agile delivery team to design, develop, and maintain reliable integrations for Software Asset Management and other IT asset-related data. You will build APIs and automated data flows between our applications and surrounding systems, ensuring that data is accurate, consistent, and available where it creates the most value. The role includes working with complex data models and supporting areas such as software discovery, inventory, compliance, and license management, with BI and reporting as a smaller part of the work. You will develop using modern technologies and practices such as CI/CD, pair programming, and GitHub Copilot. Our team values open collaboration, continuous learning, and knowledge sharing through initiatives such as “Demo Fridays,” giving you the opportunity to grow and make a real impact alongside both junior and senior developers.

To thrive in this role, we believe you have:

3+ years' experience in .NET, C#, and strong SQL Server skills, including data modeling and queries.
Experience developing and maintaining REST APIs, with a good understanding of complex data flows.
Proven experience with GitHub, CI/CD, and Kubernetes.
BI development skills (e.g., Power BI, Crystal Reports)
A proactive mindset with strong ownership of delivery and a collaborative approach in Agile/DevOps environments.
Fluency in English
Experience with IT Asset Management is a significant advantage.

What we offer:

Work with modern and exiting technology
Agile and modern ways of working
A flat hierarchy and openness to share ideas, opinions and points of views
Extensive training and learning opportunities
Challenging, cutting-edge work
Work-life balance

Since we select candidates continuously, feel free to send in your application today via the link in this ad, but no later than 2026-10-05. If you have questions about the position, please contact Mikaela Sterner, mikaela.sterner@seb.se, note that we will not process applications via email.

Please be aware that our final candidates undergo background checks, a process that includes for example identity control, verification of qualifications, credit checks, company engagements and history of crime. jobs.title: Application Developer
jobs.description:
NAPA Design Solutions offers a comprehensive solution for 3D ship modeling and design tools covering hull form design and hydrodynamics, hydrostatics and stability, structural design, and information sharing across the shipbuilding process. These are among the most powerful tools in the industry, trusted by the world's largest shipyards and classification societies.

The role: what is it about?

The team is now looking for a Software Developer who will focus on application usability development with .NET, C#, WPF and XAML. Development, testing, and maintenance of the NAPA ship design solutions are part of your daily work. In this role you will mainly work on developing NAPA Engineer , a modern design and computing platform for naval architects. It combines trusted NAPA calculation capabilities with a redesigned, intuitive user experience and a powerful visual approach to engineering workflows. You can read more about the solution at: https://www.napa.fi/software-and-services/ship-design/software/napa-engineer/

You will do this work with artificial intelligence (AI) as a normal part of your toolchain. We use agentic coding capability across our development teams, which means using AI coding agents to plan, write, test, review and refactor code, and doing it in a way that improves both delivery speed and code quality. We expect you to use these tools in your daily work, to help us learn where they work well and where they do not, and to share those learnings with your team.

You will be working with Windows desktop applications, native libraries, third-party components, including a 3D graphics library, database engines, a licensing solution, and more
.
This job is permanent and full-time
.

Your team and job location

You will work in an international team where your closest colleagues are experienced software developers and naval architectural domain experts who will support you in your role. You will also interact with local and global colleagues
from various teams in software development, UX design, DevOps, and sales. Together with them you will also shape how we use AI coding agents in practice, from tooling choices to review practices.

Our office is located in Helsinki (Ruoholahti), and you can work at the office or in hybrid mode
.
We hope to meet you at our Helsinki office regularly. We require you to be eligible to work in Finland.

What are we looking for?

What matters most: you're curious about UI development, energized by AI-assisted development tools, and hungry to solve real problems as a self-starter
. If the visual side of UI excites you too, that's a big plus.

Our ideal candidate would have:

Academic degree in a relevant field such as computer science, mathematics, physics, naval architecture, or engineering
Completed basic studies and/or having a good understanding of algorithms, data structures, and OOP (object-oriented programming)
2+ years of experience in building native Windows desktop applications
Experience in UI design
Experience using WPF, C#, and XAML
Understanding of user experience and the ability to apply it in your own design work
Hands-on experience of using AI coding assistants or coding agents in real development work, together with the judgment to review, test and take responsibility for what they produce
Interest in NAPA’s domain (maritime business)

Additionally, the following skills would be considered an advantage:

Experience with agentic coding workflows
Knowledge or studies in usability
Experience with database solutions
Experience in automated testing methods
Knowledge of software reliability and maintainability
Experience in CAD or CAE applications

You do not need to tick every box on these lists. If this role feels like a good fit for you and you have most of what we are looking for, we hope you will apply.

We work in English
across all our offices, so you need to be comfortable using it in your daily work, both in writing and in conversation.

Why you will enjoy working in this role

You get to combine modern desktop application development on a next-generation engineering platform, combined with AI agentic development that we are scaling across the company
The design work of the world's largest shipyards and classification societies happens in the software you develop
Great colleagues with expertise in, for example, naval architecture, software development and UX design
A global team of 230 experts who support you and share what they know
When you join NAPA, you will be assigned an onboarding buddy who will help ensure a smooth start and introduce you to the NAPA way of working

Ready to get on board and join the napa crew?

We kindly ask you to send your application and CV to us as soon as possible (by clicking the "Apply for this job" button on the job ad page), but no later than 11 October 2026
. The position will be filled as soon as a suitable candidate has been found.

For more information about the position, please send your questions by e-mail to jobs@napa.fi . Notice that we cannot accept job applications sent by e-mail.

NAPA as a company and as an employer

With over 35 years of operation, NAPA is a leading software and data services provider for ship design and operations to enable safe, sustainable, and future-proof maritime industry. Headquartered in Finland, NAPA employs 230 experts, combining expertise in naval architecture, fleet operations and digital services. NAPA operates globally, with a presence in Japan, Korea, China, Singapore, the USA, Germany, Greece, Romania and India.

With over 90% of new vessels built by NAPA customers, NAPA’s ship design software is the global de facto standard in shipbuilding. Furthermore, NAPA is a market leader in ship stability management and safety data services for passenger ships, and its cloud-based solutions for ship performance monitoring and voyage optimization support shipping’s decarbonization journey. For more information, visit www.napa.fi .

Meaningful work

We are proud to play our part in creating a sustainable world, and a career at NAPA means working with a purpose. We focus on building the best possible products for our customers, with whom we have close and long-lasting relationships. We protect the environment and human life at sea by powering safer and greener vessels with our technology.

NAPA way of working

At NAPA, we lead and manage the company together. We help and learn from each other, while making impactful decisions for a cleaner, safer maritime industry.
At its heart, our co-leadership philosophy is founded on trust. We trust that our people are smart enough that if they make a decision, having consulted the right people, it will be good for our company. And if it's not the right decision on that occasion, that's fine too. We trust that we'll make it right, learn from the decision, and grow as a company as a result.

Enjoy working together

...is one of our core values. Learning from and respecting each other provides a healthy and pleasant working environment. We, as NAPArians, share our knowledge and help each other when needed. NAPA has offices and customers around the world, and you will be able to meet people from many different cultures. We are a diverse team with a shared goal.
Read more about our values and culture: https://www.napa.fi/careers/

Our commitment to sustainability and core competence in innovative R&D ensure that we not only meet but exceed industry standards, delivering efficient solutions to our customers worldwide. Are you inspired by connected machines, digital services and turning data into practical customer value? In this role, you will play an important part in developing Tana’s digital services portfolio, including TanaConnect, eSpares and future AI-enabled solutions.

As a Digital Solutions Engineer, you act as the link between business needs, solution users and software development teams. You ensure that digital solutions meet customer needs, support Tana’s long-term vision and deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle.

You coordinate day-to-day cooperation with our digital development partners, including sprint activities, requirement clarification and development follow-up. You monitor progress and quality, ensure that agreed requirements are met and escalate technical, schedule or resource-related risks when needed.

You gather and analyze requirements from customers, dealers and Tana internal teams and translate them into clear technical specifications. You maintain development backlogs, coordinate acceptance testing and validate delivered functionality against the agreed requirements.

You support the continuous development of TanaConnect and other customer- and dealer-facing digital services. You contribute to the implementation of approved roadmap initiatives and releases and drive continuous improvement across the digital service lifecycle.

You also participate in the development of data-driven services, analytics and AI-enabled solutions. This includes initiatives related to predictive maintenance, intelligent reporting and machine performance monitoring, as well as evaluating new technologies and development opportunities.

In this role, you collaborate closely with customers, dealers, internal stakeholders and external partners in digitalization, integration and AI projects. Through your work, you help ensure that business needs, technical development and customer value remain aligned.

What we expect from you: 

We are looking for a technically minded professional with relevant education in software engineering, information technology, automation, data engineering or another related field. Equivalent practical experience may also provide a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.

You have previous experience in digital services, software products, industrial IoT solutions or a similar environment. You understand requirements engineering, backlog management, testing and release coordination, and are familiar with agile software development practices.

You have a good understanding of cloud services, APIs, integrations and data platforms. Experience in coordinating external development partners and working with multiple stakeholders is important.

Experience in fleet management, telematics, industrial IoT, mobile machinery, industrial equipment or heavy-duty vehicle environments is considered an advantage. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps or similar platforms is also beneficial. Fluency in written and spoken English is required; Finnish is considered an advantage.

You will become part of a skilled and collaborative R&D organization, where your work will directly influence how Tana’s connected machines and digital services evolve and create value for customers.

The position gives you the opportunity to broaden your expertise across industrial IoT, cloud technologies, data analytics and AI in an international technology company. You will work closely with engineering professionals, software development partners and stakeholders across the business, providing a wide perspective on both our products and customer needs.

Our culture is practical, open and collaborative, with a shared commitment to moving ideas into action. At Tana, you can make a tangible contribution to digital solutions used globally while supporting more efficient and sustainable waste management.

If you are ready to help shape the next generation of Tana’s digital services and turn connected-machine data into meaningful solutions, we would love to hear from you!

Reports to:
Knowledge Intelligence Pod (KIP) Lead

Working Pattern :
Full Time

Location:
Singapore

This role is based in Singapore and we're not able to offer relocation support for candidates outside this location. Applicants must already be based in or eligible to work in this location.

About Multiplier

Multiplier Holdings is a VC-backed startup that acquires and scales professional services firms with AI and automation. We operate in regulated, high-stakes verticals like tax and corporate accounting, where complex workflows and talent shortages make automation especially valuable.

Unlike traditional software vendors, we combine technology and service delivery under one roof, building in-house AI and workflow components configured per firm to boost efficiency and improve the experience for clients and staff. Learn more at multiplierholdings.com.

About The Knowledge Intelligence Pod

The Knowledge Intelligence Pod (KIP) is a vertical product team that owns knowledge-heavy product experiences end-to-end.

KIP helps firms and internal pods find the right information, extract the right facts, verify the evidence behind those facts, and use that knowledge to answer client information requests, prepare accounting working papers, and review documents. The team owns both user-facing product experiences and the core services behind them: document intelligence, search and retrieval, evidence/provenance, answering systems, evaluation, and quality loops.

About The Role

We are looking for a Senior/Staff Engineer
to help define and build the technical foundation for KIP.

This is a hands-on technical leadership role spanning product engineering, systems architecture, applied AI, and correctness and reliability. You will write production code, design durable abstractions, set technical direction, mentor other engineers, and stay close enough to users to know whether the system is actually making professionals faster and more confident.

Beyond building these systems, you’ll own how they perform, scale, and stay reliable once real professionals depend on them.

What You'll Own

KIP already runs extraction, retrieval, review, and answering systems in real tax workflows. As Staff Engineer, you'll own the core and scale what's working:

Artifact-First Knowledge Platform

Evolve the core data model across documents, emails, uploads, and new sources.
Harden the workflow we run today: ingest, extract, correct, approve, search.
Extend the APIs behind extracted data, provenance, corrections, and approvals.
Push abstractions so new firms onboard without bespoke work.

Document Retrieval, Structuring, and Quality Control

Own the extractors, document analytics, and review surfaces in production.
Deepen structured outputs with confidence signals, provenance, and correction paths.
Expand observability: traces, prompt/model versions, failure modes, regressions.

Full-Stack Product Ownership

Own the review, correction, and answering surfaces professionals use.
Partner with tax professionals and accountants to automate their real workflows.
Turn ambiguous problems into scoped bets and shipped systems.

Technical Leadership

Set technical direction as systems scale across firms and pods.
Mentor engineers through design reviews, pairing, and hardening.
Raise the bar on testing, evals, observability, and security.
Partner with the Pod Lead to own the roadmap.

Who You Are

8+ years building software, including Staff-level technical leadership on complex systems.
Product-minded and close to users. You judge success by whether professionals work faster and trust the output, not just whether the system returned a response, and you'll sit with tax pros and accountants to watch real work firsthand.
Strong across the stack. You move comfortably between backend systems, APIs, data models, review UIs, and production debugging.
Ideally experienced with applied AI and/or financial systems and data. You've worked deeply with LLMs, retrieval, extraction, and agents, or with the data behind financial and accounting workflows.
Calm with ambiguity, high on ownership. You turn a fuzzy problem into a plan, a shipped system, and a measurable feedback loop, validating hypotheses and adapting as you learn, without waiting for perfect specs.
A strong technical communicator. You write crisp design docs, explain tradeoffs plainly, and align engineering, product, and domain experts around a path forward.

What This Role Is Not

A research-only AI role. You'll experiment with models, retrieval, and agents, but the job is shipping reliable systems into real workflows.
A prompt-engineering-only role. Prompting matters, but the hard work is systems design, evaluation, and earning user trust.
An internal platform or infrastructure-only role. KIP is a vertical product team measured by direct customer value, not internal tickets.
A pure people-management role. You'll lead technically and mentor engineers, but this is a hands-on Staff Engineer role.

Why Join Us

You'll help build the knowledge layer for AI-native professional services firms: the systems that turn messy documents, communications, and firm knowledge into structured, verifiable intelligence professionals can act on. KIP sits at the intersection of financial data and applied AI, where correctness is non-negotiable and the bar for accuracy is high.

The work is early enough that you can shape the architecture, engineering standards, and product direction, and real enough that you'll see whether staff trust what you build and whether it removes painful manual work. If you want to build applied AI systems that become dependable infrastructure for high-stakes professional work, this is it.

What We Offer

A high-impact Staff Engineer role shaping KIP's technical foundation, with direct access to real users and fast feedback loops.
Scope to influence architecture across extraction, retrieval, evaluation, and product surfaces.
Competitive salary plus performance-based bonus and equity.
Unlimited paid leave to rest and recharge.
Remote or flexible hybrid work depending on location.
Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance.

Mimari ve Geliştirme: B2B ve B2C servislerinin bir arada çalıştığı, ölçeklenebilir ve yüksek performanslı backend mimarisini tasarlamak ve bizzat geliştirmek.

jobs.description:
Heb je de kennis, de flair en het inlevingsvermogen om, als Solution Architect, onze klanten op een inspirerende manier mee te nemen in een traject om hun Customer Experience te verbeteren? Ben je gebeten door Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE en ben je op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging? Kom dan in ons Customer Engagement team meewerken aan innovatieve projecten voor onze klanten, gebruik makend van de verschillende technologieën uit de Microsoft Dynamics 365 stack. Wij zijn Cegeka Business Solutions België, een team van +- 310 gepassioneerde consultants werkend aan innovatieve en complexe ERP en CRM projecten. Naast het Microsoft Gold Partner statuut en het Inner Circle Label werden we in 2023 benoemd tot Western Europe Partner of the Year in de categorie van Business Applications Cloud, in 2024 Microsoft Partner of The Year in België en Global Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Partner of the Year in 2025. Ons CRM-team is op enkele jaren tijd gegroeid naar 50 gepassioneerde en gemotiveerde CE consultants, elk met verschillende expertisedomeinen. Zin om mee te schrijven aan ons verhaal? Lees dan zeker verder!

Als Solution Architect ben je de sleutelfiguur in het traject van onze (potentiële) klanten die de digitale transitie van hun huidige omgeving naar het Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform maken.
Je vertaalt de wensen van de klant in een conceptuele en kwalitatieve totaaloplossing. Deze implementeer je samen met de projectmanager, de technical architect en consultants. Van kick-off tot Go Live ben jij verantwoordelijk voor de inhoudelijke en technische realisatie van de Microsoft Dynamics 365 CE oplossing.
Als Solution Architect sta je centraal tussen de klant, het Cegeka projectteam en de oplossing. Het is jouw taak om vanaf het concept tot aan de oplevering ervoor te zorgen dat het totale systeem functioneert zoals jij dat bedacht hebt. Van integratie tot volledige overgang, zorg jij voor een tevreden Dynamics 365 klant.

Wat breng jij mee?

Je hebt een sterke kennis opgebouwd van Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement en hebt verschillende succesvolle implementaties op je palmares.
Je bent een leider en je hebt ervaring in het functioneel aansturen van een team.
Je bent in staat om autonoom de analyse en de design binnen meerdere processen in te richten.
Je kan zelfstandig werken en communiceert vlot met zowel interne collega's als externe klanten.
Je bent gebeten door Customer Experience!
Je voelt je als een vis in het water binnen de resultaatsgerichte, no-nonsense aanpak van Cegeka.
Je hebt een bachelor of master diploma.

Wat hebben wij jou te bieden?

We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat elke medewerker zijn potentieel kan realiseren.
Je start bij een Top Employer!
Een marktconform loon aangevuld met extralegale voordelen. Een elektrische wagen met laadpas of een mobiliteitsbudget, maaltijdcheques, ecocheques, een interessante groeps- en hospitalisatieverzekering, een gsm-abonnement, een forfaitaire onkostenvergoeding, een krachtige laptop en de mogelijkheid om je salarispakket een eigen accent te geven dankzij ons Flex Reward Plan.
Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans.
Een top team: waarin nieuwe frisse ideeën en initiatieven steeds welkom zijn! Team-events, maandelijkse happy hours en een steeds legendarisch bedrijfsfeest horen daar ook bij.
Begeleiding op maat: doorheen jouw carrière word je begeleid door onze people managers. Zo heb je een aanspreekpunt, een persoonlijke coach én een sparringpartner.

We hechten waarde aan duurzaamheid door CO2-neutraliteit na te streven met de elektrificatie van ons wagenpark en een milieuvriendelijk datacenter. jobs.title: Enterprise Solution Architect – Technology & Digital Platforms – Brussels
jobs.description:
Our partner is a growing Belgian group developing technology-driven solutions across mobility and energy.

As its different platforms, products and services continue to grow and become increasingly integrated, technology plays a central role in supporting scalability, operational excellence and compliance. The organisation is therefore looking for an Enterprise Solution Architect
to define and govern its future technology landscape.

In this role, you will ensure that applications, platforms, integrations, data flows, security and infrastructure evolve as one coherent and sustainable ecosystem. This is not a purely theoretical architecture position: you will combine strategic thinking with hands-on execution, translating business and technology priorities into pragmatic architectural decisions.
You will also lead a focused architecture team of two specialists covering AI architecture and cloud infrastructure.

Your Responsibilities

Define and evolve the enterprise and target architecture across the organisation’s platforms, products and services, establishing clear architectural standards, principles and technology roadmaps.
Govern solution architecture across strategic initiatives, reviewing designs, defining reusable patterns and ensuring consistency across applications, integrations, data and security.
Identify technical debt, legacy components and unnecessary complexity, and drive simplification, standardisation and remediation initiatives.
Design an architecture capable of supporting continued growth, new business models and the integration of future acquisitions.
Own architecture-related security and compliance activities, including security reviews, risk and remediation follow-up and frameworks such as NIS2, GDPR and ISO 27001.
Lead and coach a two-person architecture team covering applied AI and AWS/Azure cloud infrastructure, setting priorities and acting as an escalation point for key architectural decisions.
Own enterprise data and integration architecture, including data governance, API and integration standards, while establishing architectural guidelines for AI and automation initiatives.
Act as a trusted advisor to management and senior stakeholders, translating complex technical topics into business language and creating alignment around long-term technology decisions.

Your Profile

You bring at least 10 years of experience in Solution Architecture, Enterprise Architecture or a related technology leadership role.
You have strong experience with complex enterprise application landscapes, integrations and technology transformation, including ERP, CRM and customer platforms.
You have a deep understanding of cloud environments, preferably Microsoft Azure and AWS, and experience reducing technical debt and simplifying technology landscapes.
You have strong knowledge of data architecture and governance, AI and automation, as well as security architecture and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, GDPR and/or NIS2, including the operational follow-up of security activities.
You have experience leading or coordinating architects, technical experts or multidisciplinary technology teams.
You have worked in fast-growing or transformation environments, with exposure to mergers, acquisitions or organisational integration.
You combine strategic thinking with a pragmatic, hands-on approach, can influence senior stakeholders
You are fluent in English and either Dutch or French.

What’s in it for you?

A strategic role with significant ownership and visibility across the organisation.
The opportunity to shape the technology landscape of a growing company active in sustainable mobility and energy.
An attractive compensation package
, including an annual bonus.
A company car or alternative mobility options.

Meal vouchers, pension insurance and hospitalisation insurance.
Flexible working arrangements, including homeworking and an internet allowance.
Access to training and development opportunities through the group’s academy.
Long-term career opportunities within a large and established Belgian group.

Ready for your next challenge?

Are you an experienced architect who enjoys combining long-term technology strategy with hands-on governance and execution?

This is an opportunity to take ownership of a broad technology landscape, lead a specialised architecture team and help shape how a growing organisation builds and scales its future technology ecosystem.

We would be happy to meet you.

Kooperativ, innovativ, piratisch, eigenverantwortlich, ambitioniert – diese fünf Werte fordern wir alle und leben wir alle.

The Role:

We are looking for a Senior Business Central Developer on behalf of our client to lead the technical design, development, and customization of core Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central solutions. In this role, you will take operational ownership of complex ERP extensions—architecting robust AL codebases, integrating third-party systems via web services, and optimizing database performance across multi-tenant cloud environments.

You will treat ERP customization as a modern, disciplined software engineering practice. Rather than building intrusive base-code modifications, you will design clean, event-driven AL extensions using Visual Studio Code, establish automated release pipelines with AL Go and GitHub Actions, and ensure all features comply with Microsoft AppSource certification standards.

What we are looking for:

5+ years of dedicated software development experience with Dynamics 365 Business Central (and legacy Dynamics NAV), featuring expert-level proficiency in AL language, custom page/report extensions, codeunits, and event subscribers.
Strong functional and technical command of standard Business Central modules, including Finance (GL, AP, AR), Supply Chain, Inventory, Purchasing, and Sales.
Extensive experience connecting Business Central with external systems, CRMs, and e-commerce platforms using RESTful web services, OData, JSON, and OAuth2 authentication.
Daily practice authoring automated unit and integration tests using the AL Test Framework, utilizing test isolation and mocks to ensure upgrade stability.
Proven experience maintaining source code, versioning, and automated build pipelines using GitHub Actions, AL Go for GitHub, or Azure DevOps.
Deep understanding of SQL Server fundamentals, Business Central telemetry, index tuning, and performance profiling to eliminate lockups and slow-running queries.
Time zone: CET (+/- 3 hours). We are unable to consider applications from candidates in other time zones.

Nice-to-Have & Plus Skills

Practical experience navigating Microsoft AppSource validation workflows and technical compliance checks.
Familiarity with the broader Microsoft Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate, Power BI) and Dataverse synchronization.
Exposure to Azure cloud services (Azure Functions, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Key Vault).
Background in migrating legacy C/AL codebases (Dynamics NAV) to modern AL extensions.

Responsibilities:

Design, build, and maintain scalable Business Central extensions in AL using event-driven architectures to customize ERP business logic cleanly.
Architect secure web service integrations between Business Central and external applications (ERPs, CRMs, banking networks, e-commerce storefronts).
Analyze system logs and telemetry using Business Central performance profilers and Application Insights to resolve locking, slow requests, and resource bottlenecks.
Establish and manage automated build, test, and release workflows using GitHub Actions and AL Go across development, staging, and production environments.
Enforce strict coding standards, conduct peer code reviews, and ensure codebases strictly adhere to Microsoft's technical guidelines for cloud upgrades and AppSource publication.

No more unreliable clients. Enjoy on-time monthly payments with flexible withdrawal options.

Enjoy a harmonious work-life balance with consistent 8-hour working days with clients.

.

Skip the typical recruitment roadblocks and biases with personally matched positions.
