*Research shows that some candidates often feel confident enough to apply when they meet about 60% of the job requirements, whereas other candidates tend to apply only when they meet all the criteria. If this role truly suits you but you’re unsure whether you meet every requirement, we would still love to hear from you.

About Virtual Vaults

Virtual Vaults is the leading data room provider in the Benelux and expanding rapidly across Europe. Founded to simplify and accelerate dealmaking for the mid-market, it has become the trusted partner for advisors and deal teams who value clarity, control, and speed. The platform brings preparation, diligence, and closing together in one connected environment, supported by transparent pricing and a customer success team that stays engaged at every stage. By reducing friction and cost while improving quality, Virtual Vaults helps dealmakers move faster and close with confidence.

From idea to production

You have a knack for turning unclear challenges into clear, actionable plans. You bring people together, drive decisions, and follow through to ensure solutions deliver real value. Because for you, the job isn’t finished when the code is merged. It’s finished when the outcome works for the people who depend on it.

We're looking for a hands-on senior engineer to join our Workspaces or Data Room team. You'll work across .NET, Angular, and Azure, using AI to support your engineering work and building AI capabilities into our products. You'll help shape the solution, write the code, and stay involved through release and production operations.

You’ll be part of a multidisciplinary team that combines different perspectives to build the best possible product. Together with a team lead, medior developers, QA engineers and product designers, you’ll collaborate closely to solve complex challenges, refine ideas, and deliver valuable solutions. Everyone contributes to shaping the product, and you’ll have the opportunity to influence both technical decisions and overall user experience.

What you will own

Delivery from start to finish
. Clarify requirements with your team, agree what success looks like, and take features through implementation, testing, release, and production verification. Close the follow-up work too.
A workable plan for complex problems.
Break projects and operational changes into manageable steps. Make dependencies and risks visible, identify a useful first release, and adjust the plan as you learn. Keep an overview of the whole process.
Clear, proactive communication.
Keep colleagues and stakeholders informed without waiting to be asked. Raise risks early, explain the trade-offs, and bring a recommendation. Present your work in team discussions and product demos.
Full-stack engineering.
Build and maintain backend services, frontend experiences, and infrastructure as code. Contribute to architecture, automated testing, performance, and safe delivery.
Practical AI.
Use coding assistants and agents thoughtfully, reviewing and testing their output. Build AI-enabled features and evaluate their usefulness, accuracy, security, cost, and latency.
Reliable, secure operation.
Help respond to incidents, investigate root causes, assess risks, and complete improvements that prevent repeat problems. Protect customer data throughout the system.
A stronger team
. Be a technical leader, share knowledge, review code, mentor colleagues, and welcome constructive challenges.

Ownership here is shared accountability, not doing everything alone. We value people who involve others early, ask for help when needed, and keep responsibility for the outcome.

What you will bring to the table

Your way of working

A track record of finishing substantial work. You can explain what you personally delivered, how you handled setbacks, and how you knew the result was working in production.
The ability to create structure when requirements are incomplete, coordinate across teams, and keep progress moving without repeated chasing.
Excellent spoken and written English (minimum C1 level). You can lead a technical discussion, write a precise update, and explain a complex issue to a non-technical colleague. Dutch is a strong plus.

Your engineering foundation

C# / .NET:
6+ years of professional C# development, with recent hands-on experience building and maintaining production services and APIs.
Angular / TypeScript:
Practical production experience and the ability to independently deliver the frontend side of a feature, not only its backend.
Azure and delivery:
Hands-on experience with Azure PaaS, containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, and production troubleshooting. AI-200 (or AZ-204) certification is a plus.
Messaging:
Experience with Azure Service Bus or equivalent, including retries, duplicate delivery, and failure recovery.
Quality and security:
Automated testing, pragmatic architecture, safe releases, and a security-first approach. You understand tenant-scoped authorization, least privilege, secrets management, and keeping sensitive information out of logs.
Education:
A bachelor's or master's degree in computer science, software engineering, or a related field.

AI is part of the basics

You use AI coding tools in your development workflow and can show how you check their output, catch mistakes, and protect confidential code and data through approved tooling.
You've implemented AI features or working prototypes and can explain your contribution and how you evaluated the results.
You understand large language models (LLMs), embeddings, vector search, and retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), including their limitations and when they are useful.
You understand Model Context Protocol (MCP) and how it connects AI applications to tools and data with authenticated, least-privilege access.
You account for hallucinations and prompt injection, enforce tenant authorization before retrieval or tool execution, and keep sensitive prompts, document contents, and personal data out of logs. You don't rely on prompts to enforce access control.

We're looking for practical application engineering and sound judgment, not a model-training specialist.

What we offer you

A hands-on role with room to influence both the product and how it's built. You'll work in an open, flat, collaborative team where sharing knowledge, asking questions, and improving the way we work are part of the job.
Salary: €6.000 – €7.500 depending on skills and experience
32-40 hours per week with flexible working hours (hybrid work, with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home, based on 40 hours per week
27 vacation days.
100% pension contribution paid by Virtual Vaults.
NS Business Card for commute, or a allowance of 23ct per kilometer (based on living a minimum of 10km from the office)
Training budget for personal and professional development
A professional, ambitious and informal work environment
Fun company events and team outings
Daily fresh lunch and fruit provided at the office

Let's talk

An informal video call (15-30 minutes):
We'll discuss your experience, what you're looking for, and the role.
An onsite interview with potential future colleagues (60 minutes)
: We'll explore the work you've delivered, how you approach complex problems, and your engineering and AI experience. There will be time for your questions, too. It will be a two-way conversation, to make sure you van also determine if we are a match for you.
A case, which is to be made at home:
You’ll work on a case that mirrors a real-world challenge. We’re interested not just in the end result, but also in how you think, prioritize, and solve problems.
Onsite case presentation (60 minutes):
You’ll present your case to the team and talk us through your reasoning, choices, and conclusion. It’s a chance for us to learn more about how you work and for you to get a feel for how we collaborate.
An offer
if we're a mutual match.

Interested?
Apply with your CV and motivation.

Remove single points of failure so no component has only one person who understands it.

As the technological partner for its customers' key operations, Indra is at the core of their business, and Indra's four values guide everything we do:

Innovation
- Our capacity for innovation, cutting-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enables us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology.

Trust
- We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society.

Connection
- We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers' needs, supporting them on the path to a better future.

Foresight
- We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow.

About The Project

Transport for London (TfL) has awarded Indra a long-term contract to operate, develop, enhance and expand ticketing and access control systems across London's transport network through to 2034, with extension options to 2039.

This programme covers the maintenance, operation and evolution of a large-scale, complex ecosystem, including turnstiles, validators, ticket machines, sales terminals, back-office systems, payment gateways, IT infrastructure and cybersecurity that supports over 8.6 million daily journeys.

Therefore, Indra will become TfL's strategic technology partner to guarantee the operation and evolution of the world's largest and most sophisticated ticketing system. Following a transition period of approximately two years, Indra will serve as the sole provider across the network that includes more than 8,500 buses, nearly 400 Underground stations, around 300 rail stations (Overground, DLR, Elizabeth Line and suburban services), 4,000 Oyster Card outlets, seven customer service centres, and 24 river boat boarding points.

Drawing on over 30 years of experience in urban public transport solutions, Indra will manage and evolve all aspects of the system. The project also envisages, in partnership with TfL, the implementation of new technologies to develop the system, make it more efficient and automate key processes; in short, to jointly create the next generation of the ticketing system for London.

Working with federations, leagues, governing bodies, event organizers, and other sports organizations, our teams develop reliable platforms for competition administration, scheduling, results management, statistics, content distribution, and fan-facing experiences.

This is a role for an experienced developer who wants to own things, not just deliver them. You will take complex technical initiatives from design through production, work across a high-performing distributed team, and influence the architecture and engineering practices of strategically important CMDE platforms.

You will remain hands-on while helping modernize systems, improve reliability, and translate competition-management needs into scalable software capabilities.

new_jobs.description:
Tana Oy is a Finnish environmental technology company founded in 1971. We are one of the leading developers and providers of mobile equipment and solutions for solid waste management focusing on waste treatment companies and waste yards.

The company slogan is TANA From Waste to Value®. We not only produce the best fit-for-purpose machines designed to reduce the environmental impact of waste, but also provide tailored life cycle services, supported by a strong local presence and expertise. Our commitment to sustainability and core competence in innovative R&D ensure that we not only meet but exceed industry standards, delivering efficient solutions to our customers worldwide. Nowadays TANA machines are exported to more than 50 countries.

Are you inspired by connected machines, digital services and turning data into practical customer value? In this role, you will play an important part in developing Tana’s digital services portfolio, including TanaConnect, eSpares and future AI-enabled solutions.

Your responsibilities: 

As a Digital Solutions Engineer, you act as the link between business needs, solution users and software development teams. You ensure that digital solutions meet customer needs, support Tana’s long-term vision and deliver measurable value throughout their lifecycle.

You coordinate day-to-day cooperation with our digital development partners, including sprint activities, requirement clarification and development follow-up. You monitor progress and quality, ensure that agreed requirements are met and escalate technical, schedule or resource-related risks when needed.

You gather and analyze requirements from customers, dealers and Tana internal teams and translate them into clear technical specifications. You maintain development backlogs, coordinate acceptance testing and validate delivered functionality against the agreed requirements.

You support the continuous development of TanaConnect and other customer- and dealer-facing digital services. You contribute to the implementation of approved roadmap initiatives and releases and drive continuous improvement across the digital service lifecycle.

You also participate in the development of data-driven services, analytics and AI-enabled solutions. This includes initiatives related to predictive maintenance, intelligent reporting and machine performance monitoring, as well as evaluating new technologies and development opportunities.

In this role, you collaborate closely with customers, dealers, internal stakeholders and external partners in digitalization, integration and AI projects. Through your work, you help ensure that business needs, technical development and customer value remain aligned.

What we expect from you: 

We are looking for a technically minded professional with relevant education in software engineering, information technology, automation, data engineering or another related field. Equivalent practical experience may also provide a strong foundation for succeeding in the role.

You have previous experience in digital services, software products, industrial IoT solutions or a similar environment. You understand requirements engineering, backlog management, testing and release coordination, and are familiar with agile software development practices.

You have a good understanding of cloud services, APIs, integrations and data platforms. Experience in coordinating external development partners and working with multiple stakeholders is important.

Experience in fleet management, telematics, industrial IoT, mobile machinery, industrial equipment or heavy-duty vehicle environments is considered an advantage. Familiarity with Microsoft Azure, Databricks, Power BI, Jira, Confluence, Azure DevOps or similar platforms is also beneficial. Experience in AI, machine learning, data analytics or predictive maintenance solutions would further support your success in the role.

You work systematically and take ownership of development topics, while remaining able to prioritize and respond pragmatically when requirements, schedules or technical circumstances change. You communicate clearly, cooperate effectively with different stakeholders and approach challenges with a solution-oriented mindset. Fluency in written and spoken English is required; Finnish is considered an advantage.

What we offer: 

You will become part of a skilled and collaborative R&D organization, where your work will directly influence how Tana’s connected machines and digital services evolve and create value for customers.

The position gives you the opportunity to broaden your expertise across industrial IoT, cloud technologies, data analytics and AI in an international technology company. You will work closely with engineering professionals, software development partners and stakeholders across the business, providing a wide perspective on both our products and customer needs.

Our culture is practical, open and collaborative, with a shared commitment to moving ideas into action. At Tana, you can make a tangible contribution to digital solutions used globally while supporting more efficient and sustainable waste management.

If you are ready to help shape the next generation of Tana’s digital services and turn connected-machine data into meaningful solutions, we would love to hear from you!

Location: Preferably Jyväskylä or Tampere, other locations negotiable.

For more information, please contact Petteri Tiainen, Engineering & Product Manager, Control Systems, tel. +358 40 762 7274, during the following times: Friday 18.9 10:00-11:00, Wednesday 23.9 09:00-10:00 or Thursday 1.10 13:00-14:00.

Please submit your application as soon as possible, but no later than 4 October 2026
. Please note that interviews may be conducted during the application period as suitable candidates are identified.

We are currently seeking a Software QA Engineer to be part of an Agile/Scrum squad working closely with software engineers, testers and DevOps engineers developing the Vimachem Pharma 4.0 Platform. The main qualifications for this Software QA Engineer role are:

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science and/or Information Systems.
2+ years of professional experience in Software Testing / Test Automation.
Experience in Software Quality and how it can be improved.
Interest in developing your test automation skills; previous exposure to Playwright, Selenium, Cypress or similar tools is a plus.
Knowledge of the approved test automation frameworks in a fast-paced agile environment.

Als Solution Architect ben je de sleutelfiguur in het traject van onze (potentiële) klanten die de digitale transitie van hun huidige omgeving naar het Microsoft Dynamics 365 platform maken.

Je hebt een sterke kennis opgebouwd van Dynamics 365 Customer Engagement en hebt verschillende succesvolle implementaties op je palmares.

Je voelt je als een vis in het water binnen de resultaatsgerichte, no-nonsense aanpak van Cegeka.

We vragen heel wat (talenten) van jou. Gelukkig krijg je er ook heel wat voor terug! Competenties en karakter zijn voor ons essentieel, naast ervaring en ambities. Cegeka investeert voortdurend in talent management opdat elke medewerker zijn potentieel kan realiseren.

Flexibele werkuren én een mooie work/life balans.
